subject.title: [Bug]: Hallucination Loop — Agent Generated Irrelevant Multi-Thousand-Word Responses Across 2 Simultaneous Sessions

question: Which boundary should own this incident: documented shared-DM config/onboarding, Telegram/session routing, duplicate-context delivery repair, or a semantic runaway-output guard?
rationale: The evidence supports a real reported Telegram send burst and a source-level shared-DM default, but the exact current-main two-chat hallucination path is not reproducible and each fix direction has different compatibility and product tradeoffs.

options.title: Keep canonical and choose the boundary
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose the owner path and request current-main Telegram proof before a repair PR starts.

options.title: Route to stream repetition policy
options.body: Treat the semantic runaway-output part as overlapping https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/44965, while preserving this issue for Telegram/session-specific proof.

options.title: Treat as configuration guidance
options.body: Document this as expected shared-DM behavior unless reporter evidence shows configured DM isolation failed on current main.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical and choose the boundary
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose the owner path and request current-main Telegram proof before a repair PR starts.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest adjacent history across DM-scope documentation, durable delivery lifecycle, and loop/recovery product boundaries.
